reason: The deployed telemetry ingest path commits one serializable transaction per point, so a Gateway tops out near one point round trip (~12 points/s) while the seeded 2s/10s contract asks for ~28 points/s. A live acceptance run therefore paces the plant to a cadence the stack can sustain. Point cadence, Registry staleness and runtime freshness are one profile so they cannot drift apart, and re-running the acceptance does not depend on hand-edited runtime files or a database fix-up. The cadence covers every point of a Device, including control points, because the publisher tick is the minimum sample interval across all points.
